name: chili-platform
description: Wrangler scripts for the Chili Platform Django Worker.

scripts.deploy:prod: npm run d1:apply:prod && uv run pywrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run d1:apply:dev && uv run pywrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.d1:apply:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env dev
scripts.collectstatic: WORKERS_CI=1 uv run python src/manage.py collectstatic --noinput
scripts.test: uv run python src/manage.py test store community accounts games marketplace app.test_abuse app.test_d1_migrations
